title: Plan Installment Lines on a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit — Hardship Assistance Programs
content:
A Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs carries one plan installment line for each loan due date it covers, and, after military service ends, lines for its graduated-return due dates. This page states the scope of the line rule, when a line is owed, and the tool that records a line.

## Scope

For a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit with graduated-return due dates, and only for such a benefit, the line on each graduated-return due date is for the graduated-return installment worked out under this policy; every other plan, and every covered due date of that benefit, schedules one plan installment line on each loan due date from its start date through its end date, for the plan installment amount. For a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit, and only for such a benefit, the installment owed on every covered due date is the plan installment recorded on the benefit when it was applied, and on a graduated-return due date it is the graduated-return installment worked out under this policy; this sentence governs no other program. For a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit, and only for such a benefit, the plan installment recorded when the benefit is applied is the level payment at the benefit's plan rate (the lower of the pre-plan rate and the program's plan rate) over the remaining months, and it is the installment owed on every covered due date, a graduated-return due date carrying the graduated-return installment worked out under this policy instead; no other program is governed by this sentence.

## Graduated-return due dates

A graduated-return installment is worked out only after the benefit records its end date together with its plan months. While the benefit does not yet show a recorded end date together with its plan months, no graduated-return installment is worked out on it.

A graduated-return due date is a loan due date after the benefit's last covered due date and on or before its recorded end date; the line for it is owed as soon as that due date is the loan's next due date, whether or not the borrower calls, and it is scheduled for that due date. A graduated-return installment that works out to 0.00 is still scheduled, for 0.00, so its due date carries its line.

| Due date | Line |
|---|---|
| a covered due date | a line for the plan installment amount |
| a graduated-return due date that is the loan's next due date | a line owed now, scheduled for that due date, for the graduated-return installment |
| a graduated-return installment of 0.00 | still scheduled, for 0.00 |

## Line tool: `schedule_benefit_plan_installment_71e01653`

**What it does.** Schedules one plan installment line on an active hardship benefit for one loan due date. A new plan installment line is recorded on the benefit, dated today, for the given loan due date and amount; it adds that amount to the plan amount due on the benefit. Nothing is debited and nothing changes on the loan itself. A successful call leaves the benefit's history showing the new line.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `schedule_benefit_plan_installment_71e01653` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `hardship_plan_id` | reference number of the active hardship benefit, read from the hardship plan lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | customer reference number of the borrower, read from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `loan_id` | reference number of the personal loan the benefit applies to, read from the loan lookup or from the benefit's own loan reference | identifier |
| `installment_due_date` | the loan due date the plan installment falls due on | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | the plan installment due on that date | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new line's reference number, the benefit reference number, the due date in YYYY-MM-DD format and the amount in USD with 2 decimal places; receiving it means the line is recorded.
